blocks.text: Match preview: Malaysia face Oman in 6th Match, Group B (T20) on Sat, 26 Sept, 2026, 10:30 am at Korogi Sports Park Nisshin. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard T20 surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 160–180 runs par score.
Rain · High 22°C / Low 20°C · Rain: 26.4 mm · Wind: up to 7 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
